installation: Same complete Ubuntu 24.04.5 vf venv with SGLang 0.5.23 and unmodified PyPI wheels in all runs.
method: Each run opened the same local Hugging Face snapshot at the revision above. The first two runs used default FlashInfer CuTe normalization. The third selected CUDA normalization with FLASHINFER_USE_CUDA_NORM=1. No run used CuTe compiler flags. One warm-up preceded three independent, uncached requests at temperature zero and batch size one. Forward GPU timers count all 227 input tokens, then 63 decode steps for 64 output tokens.
